hypothesis: Current packed mixed FLA materializes cumulative gates, A, w/u and per-chunk h, with 3.116ms in chunk_o/h/kkt/recompute at D64P1280. Existing native FlashInfer SM100 non-CP GDN consumes the same packed state pool directly; measure whether fused recurrence reduces this current mixed cost. Prior padded synchronous service result is not reused as a current mixed prediction.
isolated_variable: Existing model.prefill_gdn fla vs flashinfer. DRAMA3_COMPACT_GDN=0; no layout/conv/normalization/MoE/scheduling changes.
native_boundaries: Identical caller L2-normalized Q/K BF16, V BF16, beta FP32, BF16 persistent state, full native top8. FI consumes exp(decay) FP32; FLA uses chunk-local cumulative log-decay FP32. Arithmetic ordering differs; equality is not expected.
numerical_gate: All 30 identical-input GDN layer outputs and each owned sequence state RRMS <0.01; finite results; every untouched state slot exact. This predeclared diagnostic threshold reflects prior independent FP32 qualification at ~0.003-0.005 backend discrepancy; it is not an audio-quality threshold. Stop on first gate failure, retain it, do not loosen.
graph_gate: FI eager and captured replay outputs/all mutable states exact from same initial real state; graph slot ownership exact. FLA-vs-FI complete-trajectory final hidden and layer states are reported as drift, not substituted for same-input layer checks or WER/SIM.
timing: Five alternating event samples after one warmup each, identical initial state restored outside events, three real mixed shapes. A >=2% D64P1280 graph latency decrease motivates proposing one full1088 quality-gated service run; smaller gains do not justify promotion.
quality_gate: Only complete service WER <= matching vLLM WER+1pp and SIM >= matching vLLM SIM-2 can establish audio acceptance; no service run authorized by this artifact alone.
gpu: GPU2 only after idle check; same frozen source. No profiler cache flush or clock changes.
